messages:
maria: Pasting updated mocks for API Key manager. Looking for quick takes on create/rotate/revoke UX + perms + empty state. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/API-Key-Manager-Update
kevin: Love the layout. Two things: make clear whether rotation disables the old key immediately or after a grace period. Suggest default 10 minutes with a small dropdown to change.
sofia: Copy nit on create modal: change "Store this key securely" to "This is the only time you will see the secret. Save it now." Add a tiny link: "Key rotation best practices".
ben: Revoke flow: require typing key name OR last 6 chars. Also include a soft-disable toggle so teams can test before full delete. Show list of services that used the key recently.
ui-bot: Accessibility checklist added to Figma comments: focus trap on modals, keyboard copy for secrets, aria-live for reveal/revoke, contrast check for warning banners.
maria: Permissions: leaning presets (Read / Generate / Embed) + "Advanced" expands checkboxes for granular scopes. Show a scope pill under the key name with hover to expand.
kevin: Add small audit link: "View in Audit Logs" next to each key so support can trace. Also expose rotate API endpoint for infra automation.
sofia: Empty state suggestion: "No API keys yet. Create one to start integrating Redwood Inference." CTA: "Create API key". Subtext: "You can restrict by expiry, role, and IP allowlist."
ben: Implementation note: mask secrets by default, provide copy & download once, and never log the full secret. Also return only a hashed id in list endpoints.
maria: Thanks  I'll update the frames with: rotation grace dropdown, soft-disable option, typed-confirm on revoke, presets + advanced, and empty state copy. Meeting Friday 10am to review final mocks.
